description:
Charging point detail

Returns the details of a single charging point by external ID (EVSEId or
locationId), including all available NDW fields and the complete availabilities.

Cost: 0.5 credit(s) per call. An API key is required via the X-Api-Key header (or Authorization: Bearer <key>); a per-call wallet payment via x402 is also accepted.
